subject: Zoning Reform Deliberations
overview: The Community Development Board discussed the status of Medford's comprehensive zoning reform, heard detailed parcel feedback from board members, and voted to continue the public hearings to later dates. The meeting concluded with an executive session regarding pending litigation.

items.title: Call to Order and Board Member Recognitions
items.summary: The board established remote meeting logistics, welcomed new member Dina Caloggero, and recognized departing board members Peter Calves and Chair Emily Hedeman.

items.title: Zoning Updates Briefing
items.summary: Danielle Evans updated the board on the City Council's decisions to table corridor zoning and target a Spring 2026 timeline for residential zoning.

items.title: Continued Public Hearings on Zoning Amendments
items.summary: The board deliberated on amendments for accessory dwelling units, residential districts, and commercial squares, sharing specific feedback regarding district boundaries and historical properties. The board voted to continue the Medford Square and West Medford Square hearings to October 15, and the accessory dwelling units and general residential hearings to December 17.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The board voted to enter executive session to discuss strategy regarding pending litigation with New York Capital Investment Group, LLC, intending to adjourn directly from the closed session.
